question: How long do monthly plan customers have to request a full refund?
gold_fact: within 14 days of their most recent charge
gold_context: Customers on monthly plans may request a full refund within 14 days of their most recent charge. Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

question: How many business days until an approved refund appears on the customer statement?
gold_context: Approved refunds typically appear on the customer statement within 5 to 7 business days. Bank processing times are outside our control.

question: What processing fee is deducted from prorated annual refunds?
gold_context: Annual plans cancelled after the first 14 days are refunded on a prorated basis. A processing fee of 5 percent is deducted from prorated annual refunds.

question: What hours is live chat support available?
gold_context: Live chat support is available Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 8 PM Eastern Time. Weekend support is handled by email only.
